verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core primitives (Agent, Task, Crew) let a user define AI 'agents' and delegate tasks to them, and the Visual Agent/Task Builder even offers a no-code way to configure and delegate work to agents — matching the spirit of 'delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant.' However, this isn't a ready-made assistant embedded in the product; users must first configure roles, goals, tools, and LLMs before any delegation happens. Missing for 10: evidence of an out-of-the-box, zero-config assistant users can delegate to immediately, and independent/hands-on confirmation that delegation works smoothly as advertised.
